# 🚀 Lead Generation API Stack — 3,452 Production-Ready APIs

Stop paying **$99/month for Apollo** or **$15k/year for ZoomInfo**. Build your own lead gen engine using these production-ready APIs for a fraction of the cost.

This repository is a curated subset of the [API-mega-list](https://github.com/cporter202/API-mega-list), specifically focused on high-intent lead generation, B2B prospecting, and automated sales outreach.

---

### ⚡ Quick Start: Extract 1,000 Leads in 5 Lines of Code
Use the **Leads Finder ($1.5/1k)** to pull emails, phones, and LinkedIn profiles instantly.

```python
import requests

# Apollo Alternative: Get verified B2B leads for $1.50 per 1,000 results
url = "https://api.apify.com/v2/acts/code_crafter~leads-finder/runs?token=YOUR_TOKEN"
data = {"queries": ["SaaS Founders in San Francisco"], "maxItems": 100}

# Run the scraper and get structured JSON data
response = requests.post(url, json=data).json()
print(f"Extracted {len(response['data'])} leads!")
```
